specSheet.heading: Specifications

rows.label: Materials
rows.value: 12 mm birch plywood plates, 3 mm galvanized steel plates

rows.label: Stand
rows.value: 3D printed in PETG, easily removable with 4 hand screws, no screwdriver needed

rows.label: Controller
rows.value: Onigiri-con E-box, 128×64 OLED, open-source hardware and firmware

rows.label: Platforms
rows.value: PC · PS3 · PS4* · Nintendo Switch 1 and 2 · original arcade cabinet · USB MIDI

specSheet.note: *You need to provide your own PS4 keys.

items.q: Which platforms does it work with?
items.a: PC, PS3, PS4, Nintendo Switch 1 and 2 and the original arcade cabinet. In MIDI mode it also plays as a USB MIDI drum in any music software. Pick the mode from the OLED menu or the web configurator.

items.q: Do I need to install software?
items.a: No. Put the drum in keyboard mode (Keyboard P1 or P2), plug it in and open the configurator in a WebSerial browser (Chrome, Edge, Opera, Firefox). Everything is also adjustable from the OLED on the E-box.

items.q: My drum registers hits I didn't make. What do I do?
items.a: Lower the sensitivity for that pad, from the OLED menu or the configurator's live monitor, where you can watch each pad's readings in real time.

items.q: Can I use the Onigiri-con with another drum?
items.a: Yes. It's also compatible with TaikoForce and ZhongTaiko drums.
Yes: firmware, hardware and this configurator are on GitHub. You can even build your own.

closing.heading: Get your
closing.tagline: Ready for the ultimate taiko experience?

items.title: Real arcade rubber
items.body: The rubber is exactly the same as on the arcade cabinets, for a 100% arcade feel.

items.title: Galvanized steel plates
items.body: We widened the steel plates for unprecedented rolls, and while we were at it, we made them thicker too: your bachi will (almost) bounce on their own.

items.title: Birch plywood
items.body: ITAIKO's body is 12 mm birch plywood, sourced and cut in Italy. Stiff and dense, it throws every hit back with a dry, punchy sound.

items.title: New stands with bachi holder
items.body: Designed to be light and easy to set up: just tighten or loosen 4 hand screws, no screwdriver needed.
items.extra: And you can rest your bachi on the front!
